当你的应用需要进行三维空间建模和场景重建时使用本Kit
典型场景包括：通过手机拍摄多张照片重建三维场景、加载和展示3DGS格式的三维模型、对三维渲染画面添加艺术风格化滤镜效果等
当你的项目已经使用了ArkGraphics 3D模块并需要扩展三维重建能力时，或者在AR/VR应用中需要将真实场景数字化为三维模型时，应当使用本Kit提供的C/C++接口完成开发
接入 Spatial Recon Kit 扫描室内空间并生成可浏览的三维模型 / Integrate Spatial Recon Kit to scan indoor spaces and generate a navigable 3D model
实现实时空间扫描并在界面上显示重建进度 / Implement real-time spatial scanning and show reconstruction progress in the UI
用相机采集的数据重建房间点云并导出为 PLY 文件 / Reconstruct a room point cloud from camera capture data and export it as a PLY file
保存空间重建结果为 MP4 回放视频用于后续查看 / Save spatial reconstruction results as an MP4 playback video for later review
加载 GLB 或 PLY 重建资产并在 AR 场景中显示 / Load GLB or PLY reconstruction assets and display them in an AR scene
在扫描过程中暂停、恢复并管理空间重建任务 / Pause, resume, and manage a spatial reconstruction task during scanning
检测设备是否支持 3DGS 渲染和空间重建能力 / Check whether the device supports 3DGS rendering and spatial reconstruction
读取 AR Engine 数据帧并同步到三维重建流程 / Read AR Engine data frames and feed them into the 3D reconstruction pipeline
使用自定义采集帧实现离线三维场景重建 / Use custom captured frames to perform offline 3D scene reconstruction
给 3D 高斯溅射渲染结果添加漫画或复古滤镜效果 / Apply cartoon or retro filter effects to 3D Gaussian Splatting render output
创建会话后开始空间建模并在结束时释放重建资源 / Start spatial modeling after creating a session and release reconstruction resources when finished
获取空间重建百分比进度并在扫描页面实时刷新 / Get spatial reconstruction percentage progress and refresh it live on the scanning page
preconditions: 工程已集成ArkGraphics 3D模块并可与本Kit联合编译链接 / The project has integrated the ArkGraphics 3D module and can build/link together with this Kit
目标设备与系统版本支持Spatial Recon能力，且已完成能力支持检查 / The target device and system version support Spatial Recon, and capability support has been checked
已配置可读写的工作目录与输入输出文件访问路径 / A readable and writable working directory and input/output file access paths are configured
若使用相机或AR数据帧作为输入，相关权限与数据来源已就绪 / If camera or AR data frames are used as input, the required permissions and data sources are ready
inputs: 3DGS模型文件路径或URI（MP4、PLY、GLB） / 3DGS model file path or URI (MP4, PLY, GLB)
图像序列及对应相机内参、位姿信息 / Image sequence with corresponding camera intrinsics and pose data
Spatial Recon会话配置与工作目录 / Spatial Recon session configuration and working directory
滤镜类型与相关渲染参数 / Filter type and related rendering parameters
outputs: 设备空间重建能力检查结果（支持/不支持） / Device spatial reconstruction capability check result (supported/unsupported)
Spatial Recon 会话句柄或上下文对象 / Spatial Recon session handle or context object
已加载到 ArkGraphics 3D 场景中的 3DGS 模型渲染对象（MP4、PLY、GLB） / 3DGS model render object loaded into an ArkGraphics 3D scene (MP4, PLY, GLB)
3DGS 模型的实时渲染画面或帧 / Real-time rendered frames of a 3DGS model
应用复古、漫画、黑白 bit、颜色编辑等效果后的滤镜渲染画面 / Filtered rendered frames with vintage, cartoon, black-and-white bit, or color-edit effects
三维场景重建进度值或状态结果 / 3D scene reconstruction progress value or status result
暂停、继续重建操作的执行结果或状态码 / Execution result or status code for pause/resume reconstruction operations
重建生成的 PLY 点云文件 / Reconstructed PLY point-cloud file
重建生成的 MP4 运镜视频文件 / Reconstructed MP4 camera-motion video file
C/C++ 接口调用返回的结果码或错误码 / Result codes or error codes returned by C/C++ API calls

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建或配置Spatial Recon会话，并包含能力检查或初始化流程 / The code creates or configures a Spatial Recon session and includes capability checking or initialization flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add code or configuration that initializes/configures a Spatial Recon session and performs a support/capability check before use?

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入至少一种本Kit能力：3DGS模型加载、滤镜应用或三维场景重建 / The code integrates at least one capability of this Kit: 3DGS model loading, filter application, or 3D scene reconstruction
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add logic for at least one Spatial Recon capability such as loading a 3DGS model, applying a supported filter, or running spatial reconstruction?

postconditions.statement: 若执行重建，代码中已处理重建输出或进度/暂停继续控制 / If reconstruction is performed, the code handles reconstruction output or progress/pause-resume control
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits implement reconstruction, do they also include handling for output saving, progress querying, or pause/resume control?
